The '''Mk. VII advanced interceptor''' was a model of single-being [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was in use by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were considered new during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. [[Eldon Ax]] flew one during the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]].
